observations.title: Bracknell Flood Incident Coordination Begins
observations.text: Bracknell flood incident coordination opened this morning after river gauges passed the county threshold overnight. The county emergency centre has opened a coordination room with flood rescue teams stationed at three crossing points, and public health officers issued precautionary guidance for households on the affected reach. Residents are asked to follow the flood incident coordination notices rather than local speculation, and further updates will follow when the next raft of gauge readings is published. observations.title: Harbor Flood Defences in History
observations.text: Harbor flood defences in history: a long reflective essay on how flood planning, harbor trade and public health guidance evolved along the estuary across three centuries of records. The essay considers archive maps, flood marks, coordination records between the harbour board and county surveyors, and what the long flood record suggests about present planning practice without making predictions about any current incident.
